key_highlights: ASX inched higher on energy and big miner rally, but iron ore weakness pressures BHP.AX
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; RBA signals it will not intervene to support property
Gold exploration sector active: Forrestania hits 2Moz, Kaiser reloads Tassie inventory, Larvotto strikes in NSW, Aureka acquires Victorian mine for $8.9M
BYD declares Australia has passed EV tipping point, signalling structural shift in automotive/energy demand
Mortgage costs driving Australians into second jobs; consumer sentiment deteriorating
Stokes family retakes control of Seven Network (SVA.AX), reshaping media ownership
Tanker wars assessed as insufficient to suppress oil prices; energy stocks supported
Qantas engine flame incident raises aviation safety scrutiny

sectors.trend: Divergent: iron ore weakness pressures BHP.AX and FMG.AX, but gold exploration names (Forrestania, Kaiser, Larvotto, Aureka, Manhattan) show strong project momentum. Uranium (Infini) also active.
sectors.implications: Rotation from iron ore to gold/uranium within materials. Small-cap gold explorers attract speculative flows; large-cap miners face margin pressure from falling iron ore.

sectors.trend: Energy stocks rallied to support the ASX. Tanker wars deemed insufficient to suppress oil. BYD's EV tipping-point call signals accelerating electrification demand. Graziers challenging energy zones add regulatory risk.
sectors.implications: Positive for WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX near-term. Long-term, EV adoption (BYD) pressures oil demand narrative. Energy zone litigation could delay renewable projects.

sectors.trend: Accelerating housing price falls and RBA's refusal to rescue property create credit-risk overhang. Mortgage stress pushing households into second jobs. HELOC/mortgage rate differentials narrow.
sectors.implications: Elevated NPL risk for CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX. RBA inaction limits rate-cut catalyst. Consumer lending growth likely to decelerate.

sectors.trend: Australians feel poorer; second-job participation rising. Car supply crunch inflates insurance premiums. Tobacco tax fight adds political noise. BYD EV shift disrupts auto retail.
sectors.implications: Pressure on WES.AX, WBC.AX consumer lending, and auto-related names. Defensive staples (WOW.AX) may benefit from value-seeking.

sectors.trend: Stokes family retakes Seven Network control. Drones disrupting defence procurement. Baidu gains Shanghai/Shenzhen Stock Connect access, reshaping China tech exposure.
sectors.implications: SVA.AX governance shift may alter strategy. Defence names (e.g., REA.AX, WES.AX defence exposure) face disruption from low-cost drones.

sectors.trend: No major sector-specific headlines. RFDS rural health access concerns noted. Byron Shire 124-home development cleared, modest REIT/property signal.
sectors.implications: Limited near-term catalyst. Monitor CSL.AX, SGH.AX for any policy-driven demand shifts.

key_themes: Iron ore price collapse vs. gold/uranium exploration boom within materials
RBA's hands-off stance on property market amid accelerating price falls
Consumer stress: second jobs, mortgage burden, rising insurance costs
EV adoption tipping point in Australia (BYD) reshaping energy and auto sectors
US political uncertainty (Trump policy, midterms) as external risk factor
El Nino 'Godzilla' event posing agricultural and infrastructure risk
Media consolidation: Stokes family reasserts control of Seven Network

risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure; favour gold and diversified miners (RIO.AX, FMG.AX with copper/gold hedges)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market acceleration of price falls
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and bank exposure; monitor NPL trends; favour defensive equities
Maintain AUD hedging; avoid over-concentration in US-listed exposure; monitor 401(k)/PE policy shifts
Assess agricultural and infrastructure exposure; monitor commodity supply chains

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer credit stress and rising NPLs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight banks with high household lending exposure; favour CBA.AX with stronger balance sheet

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration and production names
opportunities.rationale: Multiple positive project milestones (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser Tassie, Larvotto NSW, Aureka acquisition) signal sector momentum; gold benefits from safe-haven flows amid US political uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure on oil-supportive tanker dynamics
opportunities.rationale: Tanker wars assessed as insufficient to suppress oil; energy stocks already rallying. WDS.AX and WLE.AX benefit from firm oil prices

opportunities.recommendation: Monitor BYD-driven EV transition for auto/energy plays
opportunities.rationale: BYD declares Australia EV tipping point reached; long-term structural shift in transport and energy demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and property-linked exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore crumbling pressures BHP.AX; accelerating housing falls and RBA inaction create downside risk for banks and REITs

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase defensive staples and quality dividend payers
defensive_moves.rationale: Consumer stress and second-job participation favour value-seeking into WOW.AX, WES.AX; RBA unlikely to cut aggressively

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and monitor US policy spillover
defensive_moves.rationale: Trump policy volatility and midterm uncertainty create external risk; 401(k)/PE shifts may alter global capital flows

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to range-trade with sector rotation: energy and gold support the index while iron ore and property drag. RBA inaction on housing removes a key catalyst. US midterm uncertainty caps upside. Expect volatility around BHP.AX and bank earnings guidance.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shifts favour gold, uranium, and EV-related energy over iron ore and traditional auto. Housing correction may extend 6–12 months given RBA's stance. Consumer stress could pressure retail and discretionary names. Defence and infrastructure (drones, tradies upskilling) offer thematic upside.
